visual_action: A slideshow of still images and one short video clip of former Congressman George Santos. The video begins with his official congressional portrait, followed by a photo of him surrounded by press cameras, a candid of him in a hallway speaking to another man, a selfie-style video of him in a car, and finally a photo of him waving.

cast.name: George Santos
cast.evidence: The entire video is a montage of photos and a clip featuring George Santos.

on_screen_text.text: you were bigger than the whole sky
you were more than just a short time

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics from a song: "Goodbye, goodbye, goodbye. You were bigger than the whole sky. You were more than just a short time. And I've got a lot to pine about. I've got a lot to live without."
audio_music: A slow, sad, melancholic ballad with female vocals plays throughout the video. The tone is mournful, creating an ironic effect when paired with the subject matter.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of still images, with one brief video clip included.
cultural_references: The audio is from the Taylor Swift song 'Bigger Than The Whole Sky', used here for ironic effect.
central_claim: The brief and controversial political career of George Santos has come to an end, an event framed sarcastically as a profound loss.
intended_effect: To mock George Santos's departure from Congress and elicit amusement and satisfaction from the audience.
